title: EEG: Simon Conflict w/ Reinforcement + Cabergoline Challenge
description: EEG dataset from a Simon conflict task with a reinforcement manipulation testing the cost of conflict. It includes healthy participants in Study 1 (n=83) and a double-blind, placebo-controlled cabergoline (1.25 mg) challenge in Study 2 (n=27), with placebo and drug sessions. Data were collected around 2012-2013 at Brown University.
methods_description: Participants performed a Simon conflict task with a reinforcement manipulation, written in Matlab, while EEG was recorded. Study 2 was a double-blind drug study in which participants received cabergoline 1.25 mg in one of two sessions. Trigger codes are documented in CC_Triggers.mat and further metadata in an .xls sheet in the code folder.
